title: Anchor knowledge context from a backlog row
action: In packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/knowledge/anchor.rs add Anchor::Backlog{paths,meta,body,bytes} as the fourth, last resolver arm: a folded .bee/backlog.jsonl PBI row whose id or feature field whole-matches the requested work; meta=title, body=detail/cos, kind()="backlog", paths=[".bee/backlog.jsonl"]. Expose a pub(crate) helper in verbs/backlog.rs that folds the store and returns the matching row (first-add-wins fold already exists). Mirror the arm in drivers/kctx.rs (hand-kept byte-parity port). Extend verbs/knowledge/tests.rs: backlog row anchors context when no work-item/history/ledger exists; ledger still wins over a present backlog row; unknown work still refuses.
goal: bee knowledge context and the session-preamble invitation fire during exploring, before docs/history/<feature>/CONTEXT.md exists — the backlog row is the earliest artifact naming the work.
verify: PATH cargo test --release green including the three new anchor tests; kctx parity suite green.
